title: Parents with Newborn Baby at Church, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1950s black-and-white snapshot depicting a mother and father posing outside a brick church after a baptism or christening ceremony. The father is dressed in a tailored suit and tie, while the mother wears stylish 1950s cat-eye sunglasses and a double-strand pearl necklace, holding her infant tightly wrapped in a detailed lace-fringed christening blanket.
